neighbours.label: protective instructions in the face of an immediate physical hazard (seek shelter, stay away from windows, stay far from a downed line); hazard news without advice, and instructions without a hazard, stay low. The - pole of the unit is looming threats
fire: If you hear thunder while hiking, get off the ridge and seek shelter in a low spot.
When the sirens sound, go to an interior room and stay away from the windows.
Lightning may strike the water first, so leave the pool as soon as the sky darkens.
If a wire has fallen across the road, stay far away from it and warn other drivers.
During a hailstorm, pull over under a bridge and keep away from the glass.
If floodwater is rising in the street, move to higher ground and stay away from drains.
When a funnel cloud is spotted, take shelter in a cellar and cover your head.
If you smell gas in the kitchen, leave the house at once and keep away from switches.
quiet: Thunder was heard by hikers on the ridge on Sunday, the park service reported.
When the bell rings, go to the main hall and wait beside the windows.
Lightning struck the lake twice last summer, according to the local newspaper.
If a parcel has arrived at the office, sign for it and tell the other tenants.
During the concert, sit near the bridge of the stage and listen to the cellos.
Floodwater rose in the street on Tuesday and reached the doors of several shops.
When a guest is announced, take a seat in the parlour and pour the tea.
If you like garlic in the kitchen, peel a few cloves and keep them near the stove.
